insights.topic: Verified purchase proof vs. probabilistic targeting
insights.insight: Crinkl has confirmed 100,375 cryptographically verified receipts totaling $4.82M in GMV — each receipt is a deterministic proof of purchase, not an inference. For brands paying $5+ CPM on probabilistic signals, this represents a structurally different targeting input: the purchase already happened.

insights.topic: Grocery and mass retail dominate verified receipt supply
insights.insight: Over the trailing 14 days, grocery-supermarkets leads by receipt volume (1,342 receipts, $58.8K GMV) while retail-department-stores leads by GMV ($30.2K across 703 receipts, ~$43 average ticket) — Walmart, Safeway, Kroger, and Costco together account for 700 of the top brand receipts, making this dataset skewed toward everyday consumables and household spend.

insights.topic: Stable dollar floor per verified receipt
insights.insight: The protocol pays approximately $0.10 per verified receipt regardless of BTC price movement — the sat-per-receipt rate (currently 132 sats) has adjusted inversely to hold that floor across a $5,000+ price range ($75,662–$80,877 BTC). For brands evaluating data acquisition cost, the per-receipt incentive cost is predictable, not crypto-volatile.

insights.topic: 7-day GMV ceiling signals current scale limits
insights.insight: The $100K weekly GMV ceiling has not been broken across all confirmed snapshot readings, and current 7-day GMV sits at $74.2K — roughly 26% below that ceiling. Brands evaluating audience scale should size expectations accordingly: this is a growing but still sub-mass panel at current velocity.

Restaurants & Dining crossed a suppressed-aggregate visibility threshold on Nov 04 and has held across every subsequent snapshot — 955 receipts and $28.5K GMV in 14 days. This category's durability signals it is no longer a rounding error in the dataset, making it a viable targeting signal for QSR and casual dining brands seeking post-purchase verification.

insights.topic: Rolloff volatility limits intraday audience stability
insights.insight: Nine consecutive UTC-midnight rolloff events have dropped 7-day GMV by $10.7K–$18.6K per event with no directional stabilization confirmed — the audience window is volatile at the edges. Brands running time-sensitive campaigns should account for meaningful intraday audience size fluctuations rather than treating the panel as a stable daily count.
